```artifact
Feature: Hospital Services Coordination

  Scenario: Coordinate activities in the Software Engineering process
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new activity is requested
    Then the system should coordinate the activity

  Scenario: Coordinate activities with guidance from Prof. Chandrasekaran
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new activity is requested
    And Prof. Chandrasekaran is available
    Then the system should coordinate the activity with guidance from Prof. Chandrasekaran

  Scenario: Provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests quality medicines
    Then the system should provide medicines via authorized Chemists

  Scenario: Provide door-step Laboratory services
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests laboratory services
    Then the system should provide door-step Laboratory services

  Scenario Outline: Coordinate activities with different guidance levels
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new activity is requested
    And the guidance level is <guidance_level>
    Then the system should coordinate the activity with <expected_guidance>

    Examples:
      | guidance_level | expected_guidance |
      | basic          | basic guidance    |
      | advanced         | advanced guidance |
      | expert           | expert guidance   |

  Scenario Outline: Provide medicines with different Chemists
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests quality medicines
    And the Chemist is <chemist>
    Then the system should provide medicines via <chemist>

    Examples:
      | chemist        | expected_chemist |
      | Chemist A      | Chemist A        |
      | Chemist B      | Chemist B        |
      | Chemist C      | Chemist C        |

  Scenario Outline: Provide laboratory services with different collection methods
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests laboratory services
    And the collection method is <collection_method>
    Then the system should provide door-step Laboratory services with <collection_method>

    Examples:
      | collection_method | expected_collection_method |
      | home delivery   | home delivery              |
      | hospital pickup   | hospital pickup            |
      | mobile collection | mobile collection          |
```
